translations.web: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
translations.bsb: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity
translations.asv: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.
